Diagnosis: The parser failed because the axis_align constraint at index 3 compared panda_fingertip +y against panda_fingertip +z using the same robot frame as both the controlled target and reference origin, making the orientation relation self-referential. The smallest valid repair is to remove that self-referential term. The requested panda_fingertip +y orthogonal to panda_fingertip +z relation is inherent to the rigid end-effector frame and is not separately representable with axis_align without referencing the same frame against itself.
Reasoning: This corrected single approach stage keeps the gripper commanded open, establishes the top-down tool +z antiparallel-to-world +z orientation, orients the finger axis relative to cube_3 by keeping panda_fingertip +y orthogonal to cube_3 +x, and moves the panda_fingertip origin to the non-contact target point 0.125 m above cube_3 with 0.01 m tolerance. The reach_point term carries both geometry and manipulator_low_effort condition labels to represent reaching the standoff point while monitoring for low-effort/no-contact behavior. Detailed left/right finger joint feedback, explicit finger effort thresholds, explicit clearance distances, and per-object unexpected-contact monitoring for cube_1, cube_2, and cube_3 are not directly expressible with the available TermAPI operators; the representable gripper-open and low-effort/no-contact conditions are retained.
